info.title: CQC Quality Operations API
info.description: FE-first operations read model. Reference implementation uses memory and synthetic results. Existing POST /v1/inspections is unchanged. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Numeric timestamps are Unix milliseconds; calendar dates use Asia/Seoul.
